cluster_stories.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
cluster_stories.summary: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
cluster_stories.headline: 400 AI APPS HIDING DEEPFAKE ABUSE FEATURES... Linked to China

cluster_stories.title: AI-powered malware ‘highly likely’ to be used to hack UK infrastructure by 2028
cluster_stories.summary: National Cyber Security Centre expects attacks on critical facilities such as power stations, airports and hospitalsAI-powered malicious software is “highly likely” to be used in hacking attacks against the UK’s power stations, airports and hospitals by 2028, according to the state cybersecurity body.The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) said AI will probably enable a ransomware attack against critical national infrastructure [CNI] between now and 2028. cluster_stories.title: North Korean hackers used AI in crypto heists record $6bn Binance theft
cluster_stories.summary: North Korean hackers may be using AI to plan and carry out cryptocurrency thefts, according to security experts cited in a Bloomberg report published on Monday. They point to the growing complexity and precision of recent attacks, including last week’s record theft from Binance. cluster_stories.headline: NORTH KOREA USING AI FOR $6BN BINANCE CRYPTO HEIST

cluster_stories.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
cluster_stories.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
cluster_stories.headline: NEW AI-POWERED MALWARE 'AUTODOXES' VICTIMS

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic denies breach as tampered Claude Code extension hits Cursor users
cluster_stories.summary: A tampered copy of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension sat in Cursor’s extension marketplace for about 11 hours on Thursday 29 October. It reached up to 5,000 users. The malicious versions tried to plant an SSH backdoor on developers’ machines, Cursor said in a security notice. Anthropic says nobody breached its own systems. A security firm […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: MALICIOUS CLAUDE EXTENSION HITS 5,000 CURSOR USERS

cluster_stories.title: North Korean hackers linked to crypto thefts among world's best, experts say
cluster_stories.summary: Blockchain investigation firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the heist to a North Korean hacking group known as "TraderTraitor," a name used in a 2022 joint warning from the FBI, CISA and US Treasury that described how hackers used malicious software and other tricks to target software developers and IT staff at cryptocurrency companies.

cluster_stories.title: Sister of North Korea’s Kim slams FBI’s Binance hack allegations as ‘grave’ provocation
cluster_stories.summary: North Korea on Tuesday slammed the FBI’s allegations that Pyongyang was behind the theft of US$6 billion from cryptocurrency platform Binance, with Kim Jong-un’s powerful sister labelling it a “grave political provocation”. cluster_stories.title: OpenAI cuts its funding round target to $20bn, FT reports
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has cut the target for its latest funding round by $10bn, to about $20bn. The Financial Times reported the cut on Friday 30 October, citing people with knowledge of the matter. Some investors reduced their commitments as AI stocks sold off, according to the report. cluster_stories.summary: ChatGPT maker is now seeking about $20bn at a $1.25tn valuation as it tempers its ambitions

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and rival Anthropic PBC’s impending public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments, the Financial Times reported.
